messages:
Maria H: Starting thread: trying to land SLO-driven routing + model-variant fallback for enterprise tiers.
Akshay R: high level: per-customer-tier SLOs -> routing policy chooses region/model variant to meet latency/avail targets. If >error or latency CB tripped, fallback to cheaper/better-serving variant.
Tim L: question: do we store SLOs on customer resource or route config? Prefer route-level since many customers share routes but tiers vary.
Jen K: +1 route-level with overrides. UX: console should show effective SLO and source (global default vs override).
Akshay R: implementation sketch:
```yaml
policies:
  - match: {route: "/v1/generate"}
    tier: "enterprise"
    slo:
      latency_p95_ms: 120
      availability_pct: 99.9
    circuit_breaker:
      latency_ms: 500
      error_rate_pct: 5.0
    fallback_order: ["redwood-2-quant", "redwood-1-8bit", "cpu-fallback"]
```
Tim L: looks good. CB semantics: should tripping be short-lived (few minutes) with exponential backoff? and must be observable.
Maria H: yes — CB should have a rolling window and backoff config. We also need telemetry hooks: per-policy p95, p99, error_rate, cb_state, fallback_count. Create dashboards per-customer-tier.
Jen K: UX: Console thoughts — show small badge on route listing with color state (green/yellow/red) and click -> timeline + one-click rollback for rollouts. Also expose simulated traffic test to validate policy before enabling.
Akshay R: For quotas: if fallback to cheaper model increases token cost per request? we need cost estimation telemetry to show expected delta. Add per-policy cost_estimate field.
Tim L: For API: add endpoint to evaluate policy decisions given a request sample: POST /internal/policy/evaluate -> returns chosen model + reason. Useful for tests.
Maria H: ops: Create alerting: if fallback_count > X in 5m for a customer -> page. But aggregate alerts for non-prod.
Jen K: dev question: how do we prevent oscillation between variants? need hysteresis and minimize flapping by requiring stability window before re-promote.
Akshay R: agree. We'll implement cool-down + min consecutive successes to promote.
cb-bot: Circuit-breaker state changed route=/v1/generate tier=enterprise state=OPEN window=2m reason="latency_p95>500ms" :warning:
Tim L: OK will draft PR for policy schema + telemetry emits. I'll add unit tests for policy evaluation and an integration test with a harness simulating latency spikes.
Maria H: Thanks. @Jen K can you mock the console flow in Figma? @Akshay R can you add policy API proto and sample responses? We'll sync tomorrow 11am.
Jen K: will do, adding to my queue :thumbsup: 
Akshay R: on it. :eyes: 
Maria H: closing — tagging doc task: DOCS-2343.
